name: The Ariana Program
blurb: Whole-food porridge & overnight-oat bowls. One simple base — rolled oats, a milk of your choice, and real fruit — finished with seeds, nuts, and warming spices. Build your own: pick the base, pick the fruit, pick the toppings. Food, not medicine.

recipes.title: Golden Turmeric Porridge
ingredients: 1/2 ripe banana (~60 g), mashed into the porridge
pinch of black pepper (helps the turmeric; optional)
drizzle of honey or maple — to taste, optional
method: Simmer oats and milk 5–6 min, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in the mashed banana, turmeric, and a pinch of black pepper.
Spoon into a bowl. Top with blueberries, pecans, and walnuts.
Finish with an optional drizzle of honey.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk; honey not counted (adds ~20 kcal/tsp). Values are estimates, not lab-measured.

recipes.title: Blood-Orange & Apple Bircher
method: The night before, mix oats, milk, yoghurt, and grated apple. Cover and chill overnight.
In the morning, loosen with a splash of milk if needed.
Top with banana slices, orange segments, and a sprinkle of flax.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk + low-fat yoghurt. Overnight soak, no cooking. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Banana-Apple Porridge with Chia & Sunflower
ingredients: 1/2 apple (~75 g) grated into the porridge, plus a few slices to serve
method: Cook oats and milk 5–6 min until creamy; stir in the mashed banana and grated apple.
Spoon into a bowl.
Top with a line of chia and sunflower seeds, apple slices, and grapes.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Flax & Chia Overnight Porridge with Summer Fruits
ingredients: 1/2 banana (~60 g), mashed in (optional, for sweetness)
method: The night before, stir oats, milk, chia, flax, and mashed banana together. Cover and chill.
In the morning, stir — it will be thick and pudding-like; loosen with milk if you like.
Top with diced peach and sliced strawberry.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk. Overnight soak, no cooking. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Build-Your-Own Porridge (Pistachio & Kiwi)
method: Cook oats and milk 5–6 min until creamy; stir in banana.
Spoon into a bowl.
Top with pistachios, pecans, kiwi, and blueberries — arrange however you like.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk. Numbers shift with your chosen toppings — this is the template bowl. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Banana-Cinnamon Porridge with Fresh Berries
ingredients: 1 small banana (~90 g), half mashed in + half sliced on top
method: Cook oats and milk 5–6 min; stir in mashed banana and most of the cinnamon.
Spoon into a bowl; lay banana slices, raspberries, grapes, and pecans on top.
Dust with the remaining cinnamon.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Forest-Fruits Porridge with Almond Butter & Nuts
ingredients: 80 g mixed frozen forest fruits (blueberry, blackberry, raspberry, cherry), stirred in while cooking
method: Cook oats and milk 5–6 min, adding the forest fruits for the last 2 min so they soften and colour the porridge.
Spoon into a bowl; swirl the almond butter on top.
Scatter walnuts, almonds, and pecans; add a pinch of cinnamon.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk. The richest bowl in the set — almond butter + three nuts. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Rose & Berry Forest Porridge
ingredients: 80 g mixed forest fruits (blueberry, cherry, raspberry), stirred in
1/4 tsp rose water (to taste — start small)
method: Cook oats and milk 5–6 min; add forest fruits for the last 2 min, then the mashed banana.
Stir in the rose water a few drops at a time, tasting as you go.
Spoon into a bowl and top with walnuts and pecans.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk; rose water is negligible calories. Best with high-quality, organic ingredients. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Pan-Cooked Banana Porridge with Fresh Berries
method: Cook oats, milk, and mashed banana together 6–7 min, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Off the heat, fold in most of the strawberries and blueberries.
Scatter the rest on top; add a pinch of cinnamon.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk. The lightest bowl in the set — no added nuts or seeds. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Banana & Coconut Porridge with Mixed Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 banana (~60 g) mashed in + a few slices on top
Mixed nuts (~25 g total): pecan, walnut, hazelnut, almond, pistachio
method: Cook oats and milk 5–6 min until creamy; stir in the mashed banana.
Spoon into a bowl.
Sprinkle desiccated coconut down one side; pile the mixed nuts and banana slices on the other.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk. Coconut and the nut mix make this a higher-fat bowl. Values are estimates.

recipes.title: Blueberry-Apple Porridge with Cinnamon, Flax & Turmeric
method: Cook oats and milk 5–6 min; stir in grated apple and mashed banana.
Stir through the flax, cinnamon, turmeric, and a pinch of black pepper.
Spoon into a bowl and top with blueberries.
recipes.note: Assumes semi-skimmed milk. Values are estimates.
